matching_policy.function_context_filter: RepoScope node type == function and mapped ENRE category == Function
matching_policy.function_mapping: Map by source file and 1-based definition line to ENRE category == Function; fall back to exact qualifiedName; exclude unmapped records
special_rules: Variable: variable name occurs in retrieved function-context text
Unresolved Attribute: function signature is in the class and text contains self.attribute
Module/Package: module or package is a retrieved function-signature prefix
matching_policy.precision_denominator: Number of mapped, deduplicated ENRE Function contexts; RepoScope has no equivalent of the GML evaluator's all-node count
matching_policy.metric_name: DR_context (RepoScope has no unified @N function ranking)
